# Try: click a few green blocks, then ACTION7
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Click first 2 green blocks
green_centers = []
for g in greens:
    b = g['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    green_centers.append((center_r, center_c))
green_centers.sort()

# Click first 2
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': green_centers[0][0], 'col': green_centers[0][1]},
         {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': green_centers[1][0], 'col': green_centers[1][1]}])

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After 2 clicks: {len(greens2)} green blocks")

# Now try ACTION7
action(['ACTION7'])
seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
greens3 = [n for n in seg3['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After ACTION7: {len(greens3)} green blocks")
